title: Source recovery notes for the ORB reconstruction

tutorial.backtest_title: Opening Range Breakout Backtest with Python and Backtrader

recovered_rules: Long entry when a one-minute candle closes above the opening-range high.
Stop at entry minus opening-range size; target at entry plus opening-range size (1R).
Backtest video: regular-session data filtered to 09:30–16:00, 100000 starting cash, 95% PercentSizer, and opening-range candidates 15/30/60 minutes.
source_ambiguities: No verified official source repository is linked from the current backtest video page.
A commenter reports a same-bar comparison issue.
A commenter reports entries after 15:45 could remain overnight.
The reconstruction adds a 15:45 entry cutoff, 15:55 close, conservative same-bar bracket ordering, and explicit 10 bps round-trip costs.
